name: Kutsuki Tomohiro
source:
Penis length: 18 cm

An ordinary student mediocre in both sports and study.  Has an inferiority complex regarding his lack of talent. Tomohiro greatly admires historical heroes and strategists for their vast talent and individuality, something he sees himself as lacking. His admiration runs so deep he is part of a history research club, constantly reading historical novels.

Summoned from the modern world, his semen is capable of bestowing power to those who drink it. In combination with this power and his knowledge of strategy from reading, Tomohiro finally finds the self-worth he's been looking for.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
